CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  AUGUST 12, 2025

A regular meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Negrete at 5:41 p.m., on
Tuesday, August 12, 2025, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA, and at a
teleconference site located at 1685 Main Street, Room 209, Santa Monica, California 90401, and a
teleconference site located at Hilton Cabo Azul Los Cabos, Paseo Malecon SN, Lote 11 Fonatur, San Jose del
Cabo, 23400, Mexico.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Lana Negrete
  Mayor Pro Tern Caroline Torosis
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell (arrived remotely at 5:47 p.m.)
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya

  Also Present:  City Manager Oliver Chi
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  City Clerk Nikima S. Newsome

CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 5:41 p.m., with all
  members present except Councilmember Snell. Councilmember
  Zernitskaya led the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica is located on the land of Tovangaar. With
ACCOUNTABILITY  great respect, the City acknowledges the Gabrielefio/Tongva as the First
(LAND  People of this ancestral and unceded territory of Kuruvungna, a village
ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)  that we know as Santa Monica. We honor their elders, past and present,
  and the Gabrielefio descendants who are part of the Gabrielefio /Tongva
  tribes.

  We recognize that these peoples are still here, and as settlers and kuyam
  (guests), we recognize our responsibility and obligation to care for their
  land in partnership with them. The City of Santa Monica commits to
  work in partnership with the Gabrielefio/Tongva people to uplift their
  voices and visibility on their ancestral land.

  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Councilmember
  Zemitskaya.

  1  August 12, 2025
 LEVINE ACT  Pursuant to the Levine Act (Govt Code Section 84308), any party to a
DISCLOSURE  permit, license, contract, or other entitlement before the Council is
  required to disclose on the record any contribution, including
  aggregated contributions, of more than $500 made by the party or the
  party's agents within the preceding 12 months to any City official.
  Participants and agents are requested to make this disclosure as well.
  The disclosure must include the name of the party, participant, or agent,
  and any other person making the contribution; the name of the
  recipient, the amount of the contribution, and the date the contribution
  was made.

  No Councilmembers recused from any items pursuant to the Levine Act.

AGENDA  Motion by Mayor Negrete. seconded by Mayor Pro Tern Torosis, to
MANAGEMENT  suspend Council rules 6(h) and (g) to permit public comment on continued
  items. The motion passed by a vote of 6-0 with Councilmember Snell
  absent from the vote.

PUBLIC INPUT FOR  Members of the public Jerry Rubin, Johnathan Foster, Dylan Moore, Denise
GENERAL PUBLIC  Barton, Christine Parra, Harvey Eder, Catalina Langen, Josh, and John Berry
COMMENT AND  commented on various local issues.
SPECIAL AGENDA
ITEMS:  No members of the public commented on Special Agenda items.

(Councilmember Snell
arrived at 5:47 p.m.)

PROCLAMATIONS/  2.A. Recognition of Outgoing Board & Commission Members, was
COMMENDATIONS/  rescheduled to the September 9, 2025, Council meeting
SPECIAL AGENDA
ITEMS  2.B.  SMFD Awards, was presented.

PUBLIC INPUT FOR  Member of the public Eve Lopez commented on Closed Session items.
CONSENT CALENDAR
AND CLOSED SESSION  Members of the public Britney Guzman, Denise Barton, Mark Borensteim,
ONLY:  Josh, Heather Thomason, Richard Hilton, and Heather Thomason (on behalf
  of Karen Croner) commented on consent calendar items.

CONSENT CALENDAR:  All items were considered and approved in one motion unless removed by a
  Councilmember for discussion.

  At the request of City Manager Chi, Item 4.E. was removed from the Consent
  Calendar for administrative reasons.

  At the request of Councilmember Hall, Item 4.G. was removed from the
  Consent Calendar.

  2  August 12, 2025
